_comment: macOS: the input devices (keyboard, touch, pen, trackpad, motion) as on iPadOS -- NativeHidInput (build-droidvm-hid-input.py's staged ShengHidInput with the board's sinks) fed by the virtio-input transport -- linked by name against the collection's IOHIDFamily (no fixture: the macOS collection keeps its symbols); the linker checks the owned IOHIDDevice vtables against the family's.
name: DroidVMInput
